# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target is physically aged d10 months in one minute.
@@ 3
Caster touches target and destroys his life force. If the target fails his RR
by 1-10, he takes an ''A'' Cold critical; by 11-20, he takes a ''B'' Cold
critical; by 21-30. he takes a ''C'' Cold critical; by 31-40, he takes a ''D''
Cold critical; by 41+, he takes an ''E'' Cold critical.
@@ 4
Target loses some of his life Essence. Target subtracts d10 points from his
temporary Constitution. If the target's temporary constitution drops below 0,
his soul has withered away and he becomes a Class I Created Undead.
@@ 5
Target suffers a ''B'' critical strike on any spell critical hit table of the
caster's choice. (The Gamemaster has discretion as to what tables are
available for the caster to use).
@@ 6
As Destroy Life Essence I, except 2d10 points are lost, and target may become
a Class II Created Undead.
@@ 7
As Aging I, except target ages d10 years.
@@ 8
As Lesser Death, except critical is of severity ''C''.
@@ 9
As Destroy LifE Essence I, except 3d10 points are lost, and target may become
a Class III Created Undead.
@@ 10
All wounds on the target will take twice as long to heal. (Note: Healing time
is based upon the guidelines presented in RMFRP Section 24.1. This spell will
not affect any form of healing other than normal, mundane time).
@@ 11
As Minor Death, except critical is of severity ''D''.
@@ 12
As Aging I, except target ages 3d10 years.
@@ 13
As Destroy Life Essence I, except 1 temporary constitution point per level of
the caster is lost, and target may become a Class IV Created Undead.
@@ 15
As Lesser Death, except critical is of severity ''E''.
@@ 16
As Death's Call, except wounds will take four times as long to heal.
@@ 17
Any spell up to 10th level may be cast from this list, with a range of 300
feet.
@@ 18
As Aging I, except target ages 10d10 years.
@@ 19
Any spell up to 10th level may be cast from this list, except it may be cast
upon as many targets as the caster has levels.
@@ 20
As Lesser Death, except target takes 1-3 ''E'' criticals. The criticals can be
of different types.
@@ 25
As Aging I, except target ages 20d10 years.
@@ 30
As Aging I, except target ages 2d10 months per minute until dead.
@@ 50
Target must resist or die. ''Soul'' is utterly destroyed.
